rationale: X independently re-verifies nearly every ground-truth concern area (NPU/XPU/MUSA scope, connector-drain ownership, full-payload-branch unreachability, prefix-cache incompatibility, image path) against cited code lines, confirms the fixes hold, and surfaces several new, well-grounded, concretely actionable findings (GitHub-vs-MkDocs image resolution, blog URL host, TP-collective caveat). Y's review is thin and its single reported finding is factually wrong: it claims the current three-dot relative image path is broken and should be reduced to two dots, but the ground-truth thread shows the opposite — two dots was the original bug and three dots was hsliuustc0106's requested fix that got the PR approved — so Y's 'major' finding would reintroduce a bug that was already resolved. That single wrong finding tanks Y's precision, and its validated-bullets otherwise only skim the same topics X covers in more depth.
